breaking.change: SFX authoring now consumes checked TS declarations directly. The OGT SFX parser and grammar, its alternate field spellings and preset text writer are deleted. og sfx and og sfx library write TS declarations; listening WAV output and the shared deterministic synthesizer remain. Shipped synthesis recipes move to styles/shared/content/ as copyable TS sources, not @styles runtime assets.
breaking.fix: Export file.sfx({preset:'click',seed:17}) or explicit camelCase layers from content/<name>.ts, importing file from @origingame/engine/author. Load <module>/<content-relative-stem> with og.load.sound. Samples use {kind:'pcm',samples,rate} or {kind:'file',source:'assets/recording.wav'}; file paths are canonical and relative to the owning module, with no sibling fallback. Use --out content/sfx/click.ts instead of .ogt; CLI seeds must be u32 and numeric options finite. For built-in UI recordings use @styles/shared/sfx/default/*.ogg. See og api show file:sfx.

breaking.change: Procedural stand-ins are TS content declarations, not OGT assets. SfxPresetBrief.ogt is removed and replaced by ts; file is now a project-relative content/audio/<id>.ts path. Other audio brief choices, requests and numeric parameters are unchanged.
breaking.fix: Write each presets[].ts to <project>/<presets[].file>, without an assets/ prefix, and load base/audio/<id> until the generated recording is available. Update platform creation and audio-generation consumers in the same engine upgrade; do not keep an ogt fallback.
